title: Knobby Crisp Norwegian Squid Skewers
description: Savory and crisp Norwegian dish featuring squid, perfect for a weeknight dinner, and vegetarian friendly with the option to replace squid with portobello mushrooms. This recipe is a unique blend of Norwegian flavors and textures.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, cornstarch, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the egg and buttermilk to the bowl and stir until a thick batter forms.
Cut the squid tubes into 1-inch pieces and add to the batter, stirring until the squid is fully coated.
Thread the battered squid onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Dip the skewers into the vegetable oil, coating the squid evenly.
Place the skewers on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 15 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the squid is crispy and golden brown.
